notes: Method: Airbnb dated search pages fetched with curl and a browser user-agent (WebFetch 403s on Airbnb) for checkin=2026-12-19 / checkout=2026-12-27 / adults=9 / min_bedrooms=5 / max_bedrooms=6, parsing the embedded data-deferred-state JSON for real 8-night totals and coordinates; then each individual /rooms/ page fetched the same way and parsed for its sleepingArrangements block, giving verified room-by-room bed configuration, personCapacity, private-vs-shared and heated-vs-unheated pool amenity strings, and elevator/waterfront flags. Every price quoted here is an actual Airbnb total for those exact eight nights, before taxes. Towns searched: Holmes Beach, Anna Maria, Bradenton Beach, Anna Maria Island, Longboat Key, Siesta Key, Sarasota, Lido Key, Indian Rocks Beach, Indian Shores, Redington Beach, Redington Shores, Madeira Beach, Treasure Island, St Pete Beach, Pass-a-Grille, Tierra Verde, Belleair Beach, Sand Key, Clearwater Beach, Dunedin. THE HEADLINE: the northern Pinellas islands DID open up at 5-6 bedrooms. At 6-8BR they were a dead zone; at this size Indian Rocks Beach alone returned well over a dozen qualifying houses and Treasure Island close to ten, with far better price-per-bedroom than Anna Maria or Siesta Key. Indian Rocks Beach is the strongest single market for this brief: mid-size elevated pool homes on the Intracoastal with private docks, golf carts and heated pools, mostly capped at 10 guests, typically $10-14k for the eight nights. Exceptions that stayed thin: Sand Key returned zero on-island houses (it is a condo-tower strip). Pass-a-Grille and Belleair Beach returned essentially no 5-6BR whole houses — the dated searches there fell back to mainland St Petersburg and Seminole inventory, so those two remain condo country. Clearwater Beach proper likewise produced nothing on the barrier island itself; everything returned sat on the mainland at Largo/Seminole/Palm Harbor. Longboat Key returned no on-island 5-6BR houses at all for these dates. Anna Maria Island at 5-6BR is far deeper than the previous 6-8BR pass suggested, and crucially the houses are the right size — capped at 10-12 guests rather than 18-20. Siesta Key at this size is real but expensive: on-island 5-6BR runs $17-28k for the week versus $8-14k for equivalent Pinellas stock. Bed-mix reality check: exactly-three-king houses are genuinely rare. Most 5BR beach houses in this market are built as either four-kings-plus-a-bunk-room (aimed at two families with children) or one-king-plus-queens. The handful that land on three kings plus queens are flagged with a 'three-kings' tag. What was blocked: Airbnb blocks WebFetch but not curl with a browser UA (used throughout). Vrbo search pages are blocked; individual Vrbo listing pages fetch fine but no Vrbo-only property beat the Airbnb stock. Duncan Real Estate, Island Real Estate and the other Anna Maria PM booking engines are JavaScript-driven and returned no dated inventory or rates to a plain fetch — Duncan's 'Poolest House on the Island' is included on the strength of its published room-by-room layout but with availability and price honestly marked unknown. One correction to the earlier pass: nothing here sleeps 16-20 or carries seven kings. Every property below is 5 or 6 bedrooms; capacities run 10-14, and the ones at the top of the list are capped at 10.
